legal.privacy_intro: Ragly (“we”, “our”, or “us”) is a pet-care organization app operated by the Ragly team based in Israel. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when you use the Ragly mobile application and related services.
legal.privacy_s1_body:
Depending on how you use Ragly, we may collect:
Account information — email address and authentication data (for example one-time codes and sign-in tokens).
Pet and care records you choose to enter — pet name, breed, age, weight, sex, vaccinations, health notes, reminders, and related details. These are personal notes you enter; they are not clinic medical records and are not used to diagnose or treat animals.
Photos and files you upload — for example pet photos or vaccination proof images.
Device and app information — push notification tokens, timezone, notification preferences, basic device/app diagnostics, and crash-related data needed to keep the Service reliable.
Analytics data — limited app usage events via Firebase Analytics (for example feature use and stability) to improve the product.
Purchase information — if you subscribe, purchase status and entitlement data via our payment partners. We do not store your full payment card number.
legal.privacy_s2_body:
We use information to:
Create and secure your account
Provide app features (profiles, records, reminders, notifications)
Send verification emails and support replies
Deliver push notifications for reminders you set (when enabled)
Process subscriptions and restore purchases
Improve reliability, security, and customer support
Comply with legal obligations
We do not sell your personal information.
legal.privacy_s3_body:
We use trusted providers to operate Ragly. They process data only to provide their services to us:
Google Firebase — authentication, analytics/diagnostics, and file storage
MongoDB Atlas — application database
Resend — transactional email (for example OTP codes)
Expo — app delivery and push notification routing
RevenueCat / Google Play / Apple — subscription management (where applicable)
Cloud hosting providers — running our API (for example Google Cloud)
legal.privacy_s4_body: If you allow notifications, we store a device push token and your timezone so we can send reminder alerts you schedule. You can turn notifications off in Ragly Settings and in your device system settings at any time.
legal.privacy_s5_body: We keep your information while your account is active and as needed to provide the Service. If you delete your account (in Settings or by emailing support@ragly.cloud), we delete or anonymize associated personal data within 30 days, unless we must keep limited records for legal, security, or accounting reasons (for example subscription receipts handled by Apple or Google).
legal.privacy_s6_body:
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, update, or delete your personal data. You can:
Access or update information in the app where available
Control notification preferences in Settings
Request account or data deletion via support@ragly.cloud or in-app account deletion where available
We will respond to verified requests within a reasonable time.
legal.privacy_s7_body: Ragly is not directed to children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child provided us personal data, contact support@ragly.cloud and we will take appropriate steps.
legal.privacy_s8_body: We use industry-standard safeguards appropriate to the nature of the data (including encrypted transport and access controls). No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.
legal.privacy_s9_body: Your information may be processed in countries where we or our providers operate, including outside Israel. We take steps designed to protect personal data in line with this policy.
legal.privacy_s10_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date will change when we do. Continued use of Ragly after an update means you accept the revised policy.
legal.privacy_s11_body:
Ragly team (Israel)
Email: support@ragly.cloud
Website: https://ragly.cloud
legal.terms_intro: Welcome to Ragly. These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your use of the Ragly mobile application and related services (“Service”), operated by the Ragly team based in Israel. By using Ragly, you agree to these Terms.
legal.terms_s1_body:
You may use Ragly only for lawful personal purposes related to caring for your pets. Ragly is a personal record-keeping and reminder tool. It is not a substitute for professional veterinary advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of a qualified veterinarian with any questions about your pet’s health.
You agree not to:
Misuse the Service or interfere with its normal operation
Attempt to access accounts or data that do not belong to you
Copy, modify, or reverse engineer any part of the app
Use the Service in a way that violates applicable laws or third-party rights
We may update, suspend, or change features of the Service at any time.
legal.terms_s2_body: To use certain features, you may need an account. You are responsible for maintaining account security, keeping login details confidential, and all activity under your account. Provide accurate information when creating and managing your account.
legal.terms_s3_body: You retain ownership of the pet information, notes, and photos you upload. You grant us a limited license to host and process that content only as needed to provide the Service.
legal.terms_s4_body: Some features may require a paid subscription (for example Ragly Premium). Prices are shown in the app at the time of purchase. Billing, renewals, and cancellations for mobile purchases are handled by Google Play or the App Store under their terms. Subscriptions may auto-renew unless you cancel in the store account used for the purchase before the renewal date. Refunds are handled by Apple or Google according to their policies. We do not store your full payment card number.
legal.terms_s5_body: The Service is provided “as is” and “as available.” To the maximum extent permitted by law, we disclaim warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement. We do not warrant that reminders will always be delivered on time or that stored records are complete or error-free.
legal.terms_s6_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Ragly and its operators are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or any loss of data, profits, or health outcomes arising from your use of the Service.
legal.terms_s7_body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Israel, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Courts in Israel shall have exclusive jurisdiction, unless mandatory consumer laws in your country require otherwise.
legal.terms_s8_body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use after updates means you accept the revised Terms.
legal.terms_s9_body:
